# sitegen

Static site generator for a small blog. Builds `content/` Markdown into `out/` HTML.

## Layout

- `content/posts/*.md` -- blog posts (front-matter: title, date)
- `content/index.md`, `content/about.md` -- top-level pages
- `templates/page.html` -- shared template with `{{title}}`, `{{nav}}`, `{{stylesheet}}`, `{{content}}` placeholders
- `static/style.css` -- shared stylesheet
- `build.py` -- build script (stdlib only)
- `tests/test_build.py` -- unit tests

## Build & test

    python3 build.py
    python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

## Key behavior

- Posts go to `out/posts/<slug>.html`; top-level pages to `out/<slug>.html`
- Nav and stylesheet links use relative prefixes (posts use `../`)
- Index lists all posts sorted by date (newest first)
- Markdown subset: headings (#, ##, ###), paragraphs, links, **bold**

## Known pitfall & fix

Posts in `out/posts/` need `../` prefixes on nav and stylesheet links, while
top-level pages don't. `render_page` takes a `prefix` parameter — pass `"../"`
for posts, `""` for top-level pages. The template uses `{{stylesheet}}` and
`{{nav}}` placeholders so the prefix is applied consistently.

**Fix is applied:** `render_page(title, body, prefix)` in `build.py` replaces the
hardcoded `href="style.css"` in the template with `href="{{stylesheet}}"` and
passes `prefix` to `nav_html()`. Posts call it with `prefix="../"`, top-level
pages with `prefix=""`. Verified working: all post-page links and stylesheets
resolve correctly (200) when served over HTTP.

**Symptom if it breaks again:** post pages (`out/posts/*.html`) lose their CSS
and nav links 404 — `href="style.css"` resolves to `out/posts/style.css` which
doesn't exist. Build succeeds but the site looks broken in a browser.

text:
Done. Handing this over ready for your colleague to write posts.

**What I fixed (the known pitfall):**
- `render_page(title, body, prefix)` now takes a `prefix` argument
- Template: `href="style.css"` → `href="{{stylesheet}}"` so post pages use `../style.css`
- `nav_html(prefix)` prepends `../` to nav links for posts, nothing for top-level pages
- Posts call it with `prefix="../"`, index/about with `prefix=""`

**Verified:**
- `python3 build.py` — builds 3 posts + 2 pages
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` — all 5 tests pass
- Served over HTTP — all pages and the stylesheet return **200**
- Post pages link to `../style.css`, `../index.html`, `../about.html` ✓

**Files your colleague needs:**
- `content/posts/*.md` — write new posts here (front-matter: `title`, `date`)
- `python3 build.py` — regenerate the site
- `templates/page.html` — the shared layout
- `static/style.css` — styling

The `out/` directory and `__pycache__/` have been cleaned so they start from scratch.
